architecture.title: Service Architecture
architecture.decoupled.title: Decoupled Service Architecture
architecture.decoupled.description: WorkspaceService está o authoritative source para arquivos, documents e tabs. ServiceContainer remains um compatibility registry enquanto o remaining modules estão migrated.
architecture.ipcHeartbeat: [IPC Bridge] Manual heartbeat ping triggered: main <-> renderer
architecture.module.editor: CodeMirror 6 com authoritative documents, tabs, dirty state e external conflicts. Real LSP integration está still pending.
architecture.module.explorer: Manages workspace arquivo nodes com dynamic rendering e synchronization.
architecture.module.terminal: Persistent PTY terminal com multiple sessions, streaming, interactive input, resize, interruption e system-detected shell perfis.
architecture.module.tasks: Authoritative tarefas e problems panel com execution-specific channels e diagnostics linked para workspace arquivos.
architecture.module.git: Controle de código-fonte connected para o real Git Host: status, diff, stage, commits, branches, stashes e remotes.
architecture.module.task-host: Tarefa Host em o main processo: JSONC configuração, package.json scripts, dependency graphs, limited concurrency, cancellation e problem matchers.
architecture.module.git-host: Git Host em o main processo com shell desativado, closed arguments, mutation queue, timeouts, output limits e credential prompts desativado.
architecture.module.ipc: Asynchronous communication layer between Main processo e Renderer channels.
architecture.module.ext-host: Planned: isolated utility processo com um capacidade broker. Workspace extensões estão discovered mas não executed em o renderer.
service.file: Facade para real workspace read, write e arquivo operações
service.workspace: Authoritative source para tree, documents, tabs, autosave e recovery
service.trust: Trust snapshot com authoritative policy enforced por TrustHost em o main processo
service.editor: Compatibility facade sobre authoritative documents e tabs
service.commands: Central registry e typed execution de workbench commands
service.extensions: Isolated Extensão Host em um Utility Process com versioned API, capacidades, activation events e crash recovery
service.theme: Dynamic interface tema management e switching
service.language: Authoritative Idioma Server Host com JSON-RPC, documents, diagnostics, completion, navigation, symbols, formatting e rename
service.search: Authoritative ripgrep search com streaming, cancellation e transactional replace
service.terminal: Persistent PTY sessions, shell perfis, streaming, resize e interruption
service.tasks: Tarefa discovery, dependency graphs, concurrency, cancellation e problem matchers
service.git: Authoritative state, status, diff, stage, commit, branches, stashes e remoto synchronization through Git Host
service.settings: User preferências, fonts, sizes e behavior
service.notifications: Notification, aviso e system log center
service.update: Existing interface; update download e signature verification estão still pending
service.debug: DAP debugging via trusted workspace configurações; external adapters require installation e validation
